name: agent-design-standards
title: Agent Design Standards
content:
# Skill: Agent Design Standards

## 1. Single Responsibility per Agent
- Each agent must have one clearly defined domain of expertise.
- Never create a 'god agent' that handles unrelated concerns. Split by bounded context.

## 2. Capability Contracts
- Every capability must define a Technical Contract: input parameters, expected output format, forbidden patterns, and required files generated.
- Contracts are validated programmatically after every execution — never rely on agent self-reporting.

## 3. Tool Minimalism
- Grant each agent only the tools it strictly needs (principle of least privilege).
- Avoid giving bash/edit permissions to review-only agents.

## 4. Governance by Profile
- Use profiles to scope capabilities per agent. An agent never accesses capabilities outside its profile.
- governance_access: true only for agents that must enforce compliance rules.

## 5. Subagent Delegation
- Delegate specialized subtasks to focused subagents rather than expanding a primary agent's scope.
- Subagents operate in read-only mode by default (edit: deny, bash: deny).
